Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]], an '''acklay''' was kenneled aboard the [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]] [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. The acklay was released into the station's underground [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena to serve as a prized fighting beast in the illegal bloodsport spectacles held in there. It was [[Death/Legends|killed]] in combat by the [[Heroes of Cularin]] during an operation to rescue kidnapped [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] citizens from the station.

==Biography==
Circa [[21 BBY/Legends|21 BBY]],<ref name="21 BBY" /> an [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]] was kept aboard [[Burnout (space station)|Burnout]], a [[Space station/Legends|space station]] [[Orbit/Legends|orbiting]] the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Zham Hlar]] within the [[Thaereian system]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]].<ref name="Mem" /> Although the station developed reputation for being host to a number of trades outlawed by the Republic, the leaders of the [[Thaereian military]] often turned a blind eye to, or covertly profited from, the station's activities.<ref name="BOa">{{Wizards|url=default.asp?x=starwars/livingforce/swlf20030605burnout|text=Burnout}}</ref> The [[Red Fury Brotherhood/Legends|Red Fury Brotherhood]] controlled a section of the [[Space station/Legends|space station]], unofficially known as "[[Underburn]]," and operated a hidden [[Gladiator/Legends|gladiatorial]] arena there.<ref name="Mem" /> The arena's program tended to utilize beasts, volunteer gladiators, and randomly kidnapped slaves, though the Thaereian military occasionally used the events to [[Death/Legends|dispose]] of [[Politics/Legends|political]] dissidents from both the Thaereian system and [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin systems]].<ref name="TAUT">{{LivingForce|Looking In: The Air Up Thaere}}</ref> The acklay, a member of an aggressive [[Sentience/Legends|non-sentient]] [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[Amphibian/Legends|amphibious]] [[Crustacean/Legends|crustaceans]] typically native to [[Vendaxa/Legends|Vendaxa]], became the arena's prized fighting-beast and main attraction. The acklay was housed in the arena's largest holding pen. It sometimes shared a portion of the pen, divided by an [[Force field/Legends|energy field]], with the kidnapped [[Sentience/Legends|sentients]] who became involuntary gladiators. A crew consisting of [[Ugnaught/Legends|Ugnaughts]] and [[Gamorrean/Legends|Gamorreans]] served as handlers for Burnout's menagerie.<ref name="Mem" />

{{RPG|''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]''}}
[[Xirossk]], a [[Trandoshan/Legends|Trandoshan]] member of [[Thaereian Intelligence]], led a group that would eventually be known as the [[Heroes of Cularin]] on a chase through Burnout in an attempt to expose the arena and Thaere's corruption. Xirossk had also hoped to use the chase to defect to the [[Cularin Militia]] and mount a rescue of [[Nim'Ri]], a member of the [[Cularin resistance]] who had been secretly kidnapped by the Thaereian military. Unknown to Xirossk, Nim'Ri's fight scheduled had been moved up. Xirossk and the Heroes watched the acklay kill Nim'Ri on a [[Viewscreen/Legends|viewscreen]] before Xirossk's plan could be revealed. The Heroes apprehended Xirossk and returned to the Cularin system, where the Trandoshan was accepted into the Cularin Militia.<ref name="TAUT" />
{{Endgame}}

{{RPG|''[[Looking In: Memories|Memories]]''}}
Xirossk and the Heroes soon returned to Burnout, to attempt to rescue a group of one hundred [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]] citizens who were kidnapped to be used as fodder in the arena. When the Heroes placed themselves between the citizens and a number of hostile [[Massiff/Legends|massiffs]] used as a preliminary event, the acklay was released by arena staff. The acklay aggressively attacked the Heroes, but was killed in the ensuing skirmish. The beast's corpse was jettisoned from an [[Airlock/Legends|airlock]] adjacent to the arena pens by arena staff.<ref name="Mem" />
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Although the acklay is introduced in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] adventure, ''[[Looking In: The Air Up Thaere|The Air Up Thaere]]'',<ref name="TAUT" /> players do not get to enter combat with the creature until the followup adventure, ''[[Looking In: Memories|Memories]]''. ''Memories'' provides three sets of stats for the acklay based on the level, or tier, of the players involved. The lower tier of the adventure describes the acklay as exhausted, and halves the base creature's vitality points. For higher tier adventures, the acklay gains [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitivity]] and several levels of the [[dark side marauder]] class, giving access to the [[Force power/Legends|Force powers]] such as [[battlemind]], [[Mind trick/Legends|fear]], [[Force speed/Legends|Force speed]], and the ability to produce [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] from its [[Mouth/Legends|mouth]]. The high-tier acklay also gains proficiency with light [[Armor/Legends|armor]], [[Blaster pistol/Legends|blaster pistols]], [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifles]], [[heavy weapon]]s, simple [[Melee weapon/Legends|melee weapons]], and [[Vibro-weapon/Legends|vibroweapons]]; however the adventure does not detail any scenario with the creature using weapons or armor.<ref name="Mem" />
